To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed an ontology driven concept approximation method for complex concept learning and presented some results of experiments with sunspot recognition data.
the ontology-driven concept approximation method is a powerful approach for knowledge representation and concept learning in complex domains.

we propose the extended multi-layered framework for concept approximation that can be used for concept approximation in ontology based learning systems and present some results on the application of the proposed framework to the sunspot data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1. How to represent the domain knowledge using ontology. 2. How to learn complex concept using the ontology structure and rough set theory.
the following issues: (1) how can we use the ontology structure for learning compound concepts from data, and (2) what kind of additional knowledge can be used to improve the learning process.

the following issues: 1) the use of the ontology as a knowledge representation model in the concept approximation process, 2) the extension of the concept approximation method to incorporate the knowledge in form of additional relations among sub-concepts and 3) the application of the proposed method to the problem of sunspot recognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the paper presents a novel approach of using ontology and rough set theory in the concept learning problem and proposes a new class of relations among sub-concepts that assure an improvement in the approximation process.

the proposed approach can be considered as an effective tool for concept approximation in the case when additional knowledge about relations between sub-concepts is available and can be represented in the ontology structure.

the proposed approach to the approximation of complex concepts in the ontology based domain models has been successfully tested on a variety of data and has demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed methodology in terms of both the accuracy of the approximation as well as the efficiency of the learning process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to learn complex concepts from data and ontology knowledge using rough set theory.
ontology driven learning can be a promising direction in knowledge discovery and data mining.
the rough set based multi layer learning framework is a powerful tool for knowledge discovery in the domain of complex concept approximation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the ontology structure can be used as a domain knowledge representation model for concept approximation and that it is possible to incorporate some additional knowledge into the ontology model to enhance the learning process.
ontology driven concept approximation can be used as a basis of knowledge discovery in complex domains.
the ontology based multi-layered rough set learning scheme can be used for knowledge discovery in the domains where the domain concepts can be represented by ontology.
